zh.text: @jasonfurman 表示聯儲局去年預測今年減息1次，結果將加息1至2次，遠低於其隱含反應函數所需，除非將約0.5個百分點通脹視為暫時性。

en.text: @jasonfurman says the Fed projected 1 cut this year but will end with 1 or 2 hikes, well below its implicit reaction function, unless ~0.5pp of inflation is written off as transitory.

zh.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies 行政總裁表示，經濟對許多客戶來說很艱難，燃油價格高企且通脹在損益中頑固偏高。客流量和銷量低於所需水平，整體表現未能反映資產質素或團隊能力，對結果和當前軌跡不滿意。

en.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies CEO stated the economy is tough for many customers with elevated fuel prices and stubbornly high inflation in P&L. Traffic and units below needed levels, overall performance does not reflect asset quality or team capabilities, not satisfied with results and current trajectory.

zh.text: @DiMartinoBooth 表示 Skydance 在裁員前提供自願離職方案，並實施每週5天返回辦公室；洛杉磯縣估計 Paramount 與 Warner Bros. 合併可能在3年內令洛杉磯減少4,500個影視職位。

en.text: @DiMartinoBooth says Skydance is offering voluntary buyouts ahead of layoffs and adopting 5 day in office; LA County estimated the Paramount Warner Bros. merger could cost 4,500 LA film and TV jobs over 3 years.

zh.text: 歐洲 GDP 曾經是美國的 90%，現在是 65% 並走向 50%。美國人均約為加拿大的 1.6 倍，十年前為 1.4 倍。幾乎所有國家都落後於美國。引用摩根大通行政總裁 Jamie Dimon 警告歐洲因反商業、反投資和反創新政策而危險地落後。

en.text: Europe used to have a GDP 90% of America, now 65% and heading to 50%. The US is about 1.6× higher on a per-person basis than Canada, up from 1.4x a decade ago. Nearly every country is falling behind the USA. Quoting JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warning Europe is falling dangerously behind due to anti-business, anti-investment and anti-innovation policies.

zh.text: 創紀錄債券發行湧入歷史上緊縮的利差。供需平衡正在轉變，壓力必須找地方釋放。$JOJO。

en.text: Record bond issuance flooding into historically tight spreads. The supply-demand balance is shifting, the pressure has to go somewhere. $JOJO.

zh.text: 美元仍然是核心資產配置，並在 @Hedgeye 交易和趨勢中看漲。

en.text: US Dollar remains a Core Asset Allocation and Bullish @Hedgeye TRADE and TREND.

zh.text: 如果與伊朗有真正會議，$USO將跌破昨日低點。

en.text: If there is a real meeting with Iran, $USO will break yesterday’s low.

zh.text: Scott Redler (@RedDogT3) 認為市場有潛在復甦，但質疑後續跟進，因之前區間震盪。$SPY重奪$763.50高點至$767，下一上升目標$774，關鍵支持$758。$TSLA自$482跌至$297後突破$386-$388至$397，若守住$388/$383或可多周走勢至$402。$NVDA在$213.85上方顯示初步動能。Magnificent 7混合，$META支持$625-$627，$GOOGL偏弱，$AAPL整固，$AMZN無明確設定，$MSFT以$515.17為參考。因聯儲局決定、業績及選舉，對隔夜持倉謹慎。

en.text: Scott Redler (@RedDogT3) sees potential market recovery but questions follow-through after range-bound trading. $SPY reclaimed $763.50 high towards $767, next upside $774, critical support $758. $TSLA broke $386-$388 to $397 after correction from $482 to $297, potential multiweek run to $402 if holds $388/$383. $NVDA showing tentative strength above $213.85. Mag7 mixed with $META support at $625-$627, $GOOGL weak, $AAPL consolidating, $AMZN no setup, $MSFT $515.17 reference. Caution on overnight holds amid Fed decision, earnings and elections.

zh.text: 零售投資者期權交易活動在Citadel平臺上飆升至總成交量的61%，接近歷史最高，過去12個月上升16個百分點。$SPY和$QQQ合計佔所有零售期權交易的47%。零售投資者期權交易量超過以往任何時候。

en.text: Retail investor options trading activity surged to 61% of total volume on Citadel's platform, near record high, up 16pp in 12 months. $SPY and $QQQ together accounted for 47% of all retail options trades. Retail are trading more options than ever.
